rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Our immediate goal is to determine <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s whereabouts.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()><thumbnail(193)>, our lead on that, is currently being searched for by <color(4)>Hayato<ce()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>First we would like to link up with <color(4)>Hayato<ce()>... but there is something we must do before that.
<thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>For the details, I will leave it to <color(4)>Holland<ce()>.
<topic()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Just a moment ago, a <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()><thumbnail(217)> was confirmed in the airspace nearby. We want to make contact with it.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Some of you may not know, but the <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()> means a great deal to us.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Now is not yet the time to tell you everything. I know I am asking a lot, but please cooperate with us.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: reworded to avoid a j/q glyph.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>The <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()> showed up at a spot<thumbnail(216)> where <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> forces are also confirmed - probably to investigate too.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>This operation's goal is to send the <book(61)>Nirvash<endbook()> into the <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()>. For that, we will fight the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>I understand the situation we are in. But this is a matter we in <book(60)>Gekkostate<endbook()> absolutely cannot back down on.
<thumbdown()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>If you do not like it, feel free to sit this operation out.
<topic()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Sorry to ask so suddenly, but I would like to ask for your cooperation as well.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: reworded to avoid a j/q glyph.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>I do not know the <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()> well myself either, but <color(4)>Holland<ce()> is a comrade who shares our goal.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>That contact with the <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()> will lead to the world's stability is <color(4)>Holland<ce()>'s claim, and I want to trust it.
